source: Browser prototype; not physical device acceptance
regression_checks: Six permanent home choices; ordinary UP/DOWN plus short OK opens timers
One short UP from the default home focus selects timers
Timer entry remains present for empty, running, paused and finished states
Hold OK pauses/resumes; hold DOWN cancels only the selected timer; double UP returns
Cancel preserves recipe step progress and prevents silent timer restart
Paused timers restored from KST2 stay reachable after reboot
